received_works.body:
Hello! I love your art and want to request an illustration of my character Fera Lune. She is a werewolf moon goddess with a bright and energetic personality. She  has long blue hair that ends with a sparkly purple gradient and she has wolf ears and a fluffy tail. She ahs heterochromia, one eye is yellow and the other is blue.

I want to request an illustration for art I can use for a Music Video (please adjust price as needed). I want to Cover Sanctuary by Utada Hikaru from Kingdom Hearts, so I would love an  image of Fera Lune on the Destiny Islands (or a beach) like Kairi. Examples provided here. 

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1YUI9FmFwjzFk2_LzhnmwDCtVBfN3FWaL?usp=sharing

Please make the illustration 16:9 and if possible, please separate the layers! Thank you so much for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1-3iX1wPnWvu_17f8LtUm6FoJ49vmYBpp

Hello, I love your artwork very much! I wanted to request a 16:9 artwork for my vtuber model. This is my first time on skeb, so I apologize if I seem rude, and I appreciate your consideration! 

My character seems shy and sweet, but has a dark side. She lives in the snow mountains alone. Please refer to extra materials for her appearance! Feel free to alter parts of her outfit to better fit the composition. Include her sword! I will leave the pose and background to you. If the amount is not enough, please resend. This artwork will be used on social media such as twitch/youtube/x!

Thank you for your consideration! ~ 
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16n-fv_nznUP22VdE9nYg4asLDIrvb02_?usp=sharing

Dear ERI

This is my first time contacting you.
I am contacting you because I would like to request you to create an illustration for me.

We have provided the details of your request below.
If your request is not currently accepted, please cancel it or submit a new request.

Details of your request
We would like to ask you to create an illustration to be used in a YouTube video I tried singing.
The song is "Shigami-sama ni Nigai" by Mafumafu.
URL: https://youtu.be/rl1Yo3Zyw64?si=7-eXLSJaFcymzi3U

Please see below for a list of specific requests.
We would appreciate it if you would consider our request as long as it is not too much work for you.

Regarding the composition: We would be honored if you could keep the world view and atmosphere of the original song while adding your own unique and original sensibility to the arrangement. We would like a slightly eerie atmosphere.
Color: Please use cold or monotone colors throughout the image.
Masks: We would like to see a mask somewhere in the illustration (e.g. a masked figure wearing a mask). (e.g., the mask is worn on the head, not on the face, etc.) We will leave the choice of expression up to you.
Expression and eye color: We would appreciate it if you could draw the expression and facial features of the character without the mask, using your own ideas. Please use blue for the color of the eyes.
Ratio of illustration: Please use a ratio of 16:9.


Usage
Thumbnails on YouTube, distribution, and use in video clips.
Postings and announcements on SNS such as X (formerly Twitter)
Use in other general VTuber activities

About the data to be delivered
If possible, we would greatly appreciate it if you could provide us with the data in PSD format with separate layers for the person, background, and text. We would appreciate it if you could also separate the layers for people, backgrounds, and text, etc., if possible, in a PSD format.

We would be very happy if you could accept our proposal after considering the above information.
We would be more than happy if we could be of service to you.
Thank you very much for your cooperation.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CIGdZlqzpUOSynzE21vmH-3uprR0oSaR?usp=drive_link

Hello! I would like to request a drawing of the vtuber parasi. Para is a carnivorous bunny girl -- she is cheerful, bratty and proud.  She can be hedonistic too, greatly enjoying meat, beer and tobacco. She has long blue hair, red spiral eyes, a flat chest, and has a large fluffy rabbit tail. Please draw her in any way that you would like, and feel free to change her outfit and hairstyle as well

https://catbox.moe/c/hmv0yc

Thank you for your consideration!

https://catbox.moe/c/hmv0yc

Hello... I love your soft art style and I'm looking for a song cover illustration for a song! The song to be covered is: https://x.com/BigRicePiano/status/1935034926501609926.

OC is looking back with a soft expression. You can choose the background. My pets are called star buns. Please include my pink and blue star bun. 

OC features:.
Comet vtuber
Sweet, charming and elegant girl
Blue dress
Necklace has white pearls and a purple gem in the middle.

Prefer 16:9 landscape image. I will use it for SNS (Twitch, YouTube, etc). I will give proper credit.

References:
https://imgur.com/a/skeb-eri-0s6U9te

Hello! I was browsing the new creators and was looking at your X page. I love your art style and would like an illustration of my Vtuber. 

Azalea is a forest nymph who is a bit feisty, smug and mischievous, and is often found with her pet bee Flame. I would like you to add a bee with her if possible and want to leave pose and expression up to you.
Aza does have fangs if her teeth are exposed, and typically has a playful or smug expression. Flame's size is up to artist interpretation as he is able to change in size. 

I plan to use this for SNS. Thank you so much for your consideration! I hope you can have fun with my request
